text:
sam: quick: after the recent degraded-search incident i want a lightweight, repeatable follow-up flow so actions don't vanish. proposal below.
jess: agreed. a tiny, enforced pattern would help.
riley: sounds good — what are you thinking for roles and cadence?
sam: draft: 1) short remediation card (one-row), 2) 48h confirm rule, 3) 2-week closure sprint option, 4) IC rotation tweak + handoff note.
tanvi: can you show the remediation card format?
sam: copy/paste card:
```
ID: PM-2026-045
Summary: one-line
Owner: @person (single)
ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
Status: todo/in-progress/blocked/done
Blocker: short or link
Next-check: YYYY-MM-DD
Link: PR/issue/monitoring
```
jess: nice and tiny. require owner to confirm ETA within 48h or IC reassigns and posts reason. that was the common failure mode.
riley: cadence: weekly async row updates for 6 weeks; if >50% items still open after 6 weeks, trigger a 15m sync and consider a 2-week closure sprint. keeps it lightweight but with pressure.
tanvi: roles: Incident Commander (5-week rotation pilot), Remediation Owner (per card), PM reviewer, SRE verifier. IC must add a one-paragraph handoff when rotation happens.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: "confirm-actions: PM-2026-045" in 48 hours for @sam @jess
sam: enforcement: incident-bot posts T+48h, T+14d, T+30d reminders. if no ETA at T+48h -> IC gets ping + temporary owner assigned. owner transfers must be logged in the card row.
jess: small tracker: one Google sheet with one-row-per-action + dashboard counts (todo/in-progress/blocked/done, stale>30d). i'll make a minimal template and post link.
riley: metrics for pilot: % confirmed at 48h, % closed by 30d, number of escalations, avg owner transfers. we can run for 6 incidents and evaluate.
tanvi: immediate tasks: jess makes sheet + row template (due EOD tomorrow); sam adds card snippet to runbook (due Wed); riley publishes 5-week IC pilot sign-up + handoff template (due Mon).
jess: will include clipboard-friendly row and a tiny "copy into postmortem" instruction.
sam: one behavioral rule: owners must update their row before weekly summary or the IC marks it as "stale->escalate". transparency will help.
riley: volunteering to take the next IC slot and run the pilot handoff notes.
incident-bot: Reminder posted: "pilot-check-in: remediation-pilot" in 14 days for @riley @sam
jess: no objections. i'll post the sheet link here when ready. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks all — if this sticks we'll formalize in the incident runbook. low ceremony, clear consequences.
